spec: 12 §7.6 (dedupe and cid release), 12 §7.2 (pipeline position per profile), 10 N5, 10 §10.2 (not a reason), 21 §10 (diagnostics counter duplicate_active_cid), 30 §7.1, 60 §5.5 (x10 cases)
notes: Rule (both profiles): placing a cid with an active generation is dropped idempotently: no event, no record, no trace record; counted in diagnostics.anomalies.duplicate_active_cid. It is never an OrderRejected reason.

A cid is active iff its current key exists and is not om_terminal. om_terminal is set by (1) a terminal event returned synchronously by a dispatch in the same OM call (ts-compat only), (2) a delivered terminal event, (3) delivered fills reaching the order size.
Position of dedupe: realistic before validation and risk (12 §7.2 step 2); ts-compat after the TS risk pass (TC-C2). Both give the same observable: a duplicate produces no event of any kind.
Cancels, splits and merges are never deduped (12 §7.3).

vectors.script: one on_tick returns [place x, place x] (identical GTC BUY resting orders, cid x)

expect.trace: one intent record per returned intent (both are traced as intents, 22 §3.3), one order_submitted

vectors.spec: 12 §7.6 (strategies re-send the same intent every tick)

place x; cancel x; after OrderDone(Canceled) is delivered, place x again

expect.view: portfolio().order(x) is the second generation; orders() lists both in submission order

vectors.script: one on_tick returns [place x as FOK BUY at best ask size <= depth (fills synchronously), place x as GTC BUY below best ask]

expect.note: the FOK's OrderDone(Filled) is returned synchronously by the first dispatch, so the cid is released before the second intent is handled

vectors.spec: 12 §7.6 (asynchronous terminal events release only when delivered)
vectors.script: place x as a marketable GTC that fully matches at arrival; on every on_tick between arrival and the fill report (L_fill > 0) return [place x]; after the Fill/OrderDone(Filled) is delivered, on_tick returns [place x] once more

expect.while_undelivered: every re-place is dropped (duplicate_active_cid incremented), no events
expect.after_delivery: the re-place is accepted as generation 2

vectors.spec: 12 §7.2 (realistic: dedupe before validation), 12 §8.2 (ts-compat: invalid sizes uncounted, then handler dedupes)
